key.name: gesture-enabled
key.description: Watch touchpad swipes and pinches and run the action each completed gesture is bound to. The shell keeps handling its own gestures; nothing here ever blocks an event.

key.name: gesture-swipe3-down
key.summary: Action for a three-finger swipe down
key.description: Only fires on the desktop: while the overview is up the shell uses the gesture itself to close it again. One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-swipe4-up
key.summary: Action for a four-finger swipe up
key.description: One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-swipe4-down
key.summary: Action for a four-finger swipe down
key.description: One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-swipe4-left
key.summary: Action for a four-finger swipe left
key.description: One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-swipe4-right
key.summary: Action for a four-finger swipe right
key.description: One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-pinch-in
key.description: Fingers drawn together, the pinch shrinking. One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-pinch-out
key.description: Fingers spread apart, the pinch growing. One of none, overview, app-grid, show-desktop, switch-windows, prev-workspace, next-workspace or launch-app.

key.name: gesture-launch-app
key.summary: App launched by the launch-app gesture action
key.description: Desktop file id (such as "io.github.hamzagouda.TufControl.desktop") started by any gesture bound to launch-app. Empty makes the action do nothing.

key.name: hide-power-mode
key.summary: Hide GNOME's built-in Power Mode tile
key.description: Our Power Mode tile covers the same platform profile (through asusd, with power-profiles-daemon as fallback), so the shell's own Power Mode toggle is redundant while this extension runs. Hiding is cosmetic: the profile itself keeps working for everything else.
